{{Quote|Gravity's silhouette remains, but the star and all the planets, disappeared they have. How can this be?|Yoda|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Imoco''' was the eleventh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kamino (star)|Kamino]] in the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]]. It was a [[Water/Legends|frozen]] rock with eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GOW" /><ref name="EA" />

Technically, the Kamino system was not part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="EA" /> It was located within the dwarf satellite galaxy [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]], which was in a close and decaying orbit around the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] boundaries, some 12 [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] beyond the dwarf galaxy.<ref name="GOW" /> Kamino circled a star high above the galactic disk, loosely grouped with other fringe stars at the lower periphery of the Rishi Maze.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]], except [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], were introduced in the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GOW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Kamino star system in grid square S-15.<ref name="EA" />
